tagline: FigCraft on a Selkies web desktop: design interfaces with frames and components and click through prototypes in the browser.
description: FigCraft, interface design and prototyping in the spirit of Figma, on a Selkies web desktop. It runs in your browser without a VNC client or a local install, on amd64 and arm64.
author: Junker der Provinz
title: FigCraft
